title: Who else benefits from the Dutch cycling infrastructure
summary: A short BicycleDutch episode showing how people with disabilities use Dutch cycle tracks on hand-cycles, tricycles and mobility scooters.
why: HN cites it to show that cycling infrastructure also serves disabled and mobility-impaired people.

quote.text: Bike infrastructure is not only for bicycles: its for trikes, wheelchairs, mobility scooters, ebikes.
